> @radeore , the test looks reasonable, but I didn't quite understand why we need tolerations for the second pod. In schedulableWorkersPerZone() you add only nodes labelled as "node-role.kubernetes.io/worker", so the test must work fine without those tolerations. Can you elaborate in which scenario the tolerations for the second pod is important?

Hi @mpatlasov , schedulableWorkersPerZone() ensures we have workers in ≥2 zones before attempting cross-zone verification, but pod two is scheduled by the PV’s second topology zone. It is possible that PV’s second topology zone can contain only control-plane nodes,  so without control-plane tolerations it cannot land on those nodes and the cross-zone read never runs.

> It is possible that PV’s second topology zone can contain only control-plane nodes, so without control-plane tolerations it cannot land on those nodes and the cross-zone read never runs.

OK, this makes sense. We have no control on the selection of secondary zone for PV, hence we have to prepared it corresponds to control-plane nodes only. Got it!
